# Feature Request Process

## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to add.

## Use Case
Explain why this feature is needed and how it will benefit the project.

## Proposed Solution
A brief description of how you think this feature could be implemented (optional).

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
